content: Af ter the transmission of an ARP request the TcpIp shall skip the transmission of any further ARP requests to the same destination within a duration of TcpIpArpRequestTimeout seconds, according to the mechanism to prevent ARP flooding described in IETF RFC 1 122, section 2.3.2.1 ARP Cache Validation.
